steps.en: Notice stage is changed to the one PLUS asked for
steps.id: Stage notice diubah ke yang diminta PLUS

steps.en: Amounts, flags and history are updated together
steps.id: Jumlah, flag, dan riwayat ikut diperbarui
steps.why_en: The court-stage surcharge field is not filled when the change comes from PLUS.
steps.why_id: Kolom surcharge stage court tidak diisi bila perubahan datang dari PLUS.

steps.en: PLUS is told the change succeeded
steps.id: PLUS diberi tahu bahwa perubahan berhasil
steps.why_en: The success reply is also sent when nothing was changed and has no status per notice.
steps.why_id: Balasan sukses juga dikirim saat tidak ada yang diubah dan tidak memuat status per notice.
